response.description: You can now receive insights where collaboration happens—in Microsoft Teams—with expanded dashboard subscription capabilities in Azure Databricks. This enhancement delivers timely, actionable data directly into team workflows, reducing the need to check email or switch tools. It supports faster decision-making and keeps everyone aligned in real time. As part of the broader Microsoft vision to unify data, AI, and collaboration, this feature helps you connect insights to action within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Databricks Dashboard subscriptions now support Microsoft Teams
